title: 第11章 区区万宝阁弹指可灭第12章 男孩子在外面得保护好自己
content_zh:
许小凡疯狂催动体内功法！
神魔炼气诀一共九层，每一层都有一种强化形态！
而这第一重——蛮牛变！
便可以极大程度提升身体力量！
很快他周身便开始出现一道道黑白玄妙符文！
这符文好似印刻在皮肤上！
又好似深入皮肉之中，给人一种浑然一体之感！
一时间，许小凡无论速度还是力量，都暴增了一大截！
就在这时，徐大师变的粗大的手掌，已经劈头盖脸打来。
许小凡便迎着这一掌轰出一拳！
强横的力道与空气摩擦！
爆发出一股巨大的破空之音！
徐大师被打的倒飞而出！
一连撞塌好几根内柱才踉跄起身！
他低头看了一眼自己伤痕累累的手掌，一脸心有余悸！
如果不是因为护体法器，刚刚那一拳他这只手估摸着已经保不住了！
简直离谱！
不过...老子还可以喊人！
徐大师心念一动，爆呵一声：“快去请掌柜大人！”
这一声被真元裹挟，声如洪钟！

“操！”
许小凡一惊，没想到对方还有这一手，他急忙看向许渊，“爹...”
一旁的许渊搬了一根凳子，正坐一旁观战。
闻言自信一笑说道：“你好好打，一切有我。”
许小凡无奈，再次朝着徐大师冲去！
二人便又战作一团！
不久之后，却听苍穹之上传来一道怒吼，“放肆！”
紧接着一道强横威压冲天而降！
徐大师大喜，狂笑道：“掌柜来了，你们完了！”
下一瞬，万宝阁二楼，一位紫袍老者突兀出现！
脸色黑如锅底！
来人正是万宝阁青州总掌柜，孙九德！
徐大师一拳将许小凡击退，趁机道：“掌柜，这两人要搞事！”
孙九德扫视一圈后，并没有理会徐大师，转而将目光看向许渊，眉头紧皱。
他竟看不透对方的底细！
content_en:
Xu Xiaofan crazily activates the skills in his body!
There are nine levels in total of the God and Demon Qi Refining Technique, and each level has an enhanced form!
And this is the first stage - the wild transformation!
It can greatly improve body strength!
Soon black and white mysterious runes began to appear around him!
This rune seems to be imprinted on the skin!
It seems to penetrate deep into the flesh, giving people a sense of oneness!
Suddenly, Xu Xiaofan's speed and strength increased dramatically!
At this moment, Master Xu's palm, which had become thicker, was hitting him all over the face.
Xu Xiaofan responded with a punch!
The tyrannical force rubs against the air!
A huge sound broke out!
Master Xu was knocked upside down and flew out!
He knocked down several inner pillars before he stumbled to his feet!
He looked down at his scarred palms, with a look of lingering fear on his face!
If it weren't for the body-protecting magic weapon, his hand might not have been able to protect his hand from the punch just now!
Simply outrageous!
But...I can still call people!
Master Xu had a thought in his mind and shouted loudly: "Hurry and invite the shopkeeper!"
This sound was wrapped in true energy and sounded like a loud bell!
"Fuck!"
Xu Xiaofan was shocked. He didn't expect that the other party had such a hand. He hurriedly looked at Xu Yuan, "Dad..."
Xu Yuan moved a stool to the side and was sitting on the sidelines watching the battle.
Hearing this, he smiled confidently and said, "You fight well, I'll take care of everything."
Xu Xiaofan had no choice but to rush towards Master Xu again!
The two of them fought again!
Not long after, I heard a roar coming from the sky, "Watch it!"
Immediately afterwards, a tyrannical pressure descended from the sky!
Master Xu was overjoyed and laughed wildly: "The shopkeeper is here and you are finished!"
The next moment, on the second floor of Wanbao Pavilion, an old man in purple robe suddenly appeared!
His face was as black as the bottom of a pot!
The person coming is Sun Jiude, the general manager of Wanbao Pavilion Qingzhou!
Master Xu knocked Xu Xiaofan away with one punch and took the opportunity to say: "Shopkeeper, these two are going to cause trouble!"
After scanning around, Sun Jiude ignored Master Xu and turned to look at Xu Yuan, frowning.
He actually couldn't see through the other party's true identity!
